title: Prefixed settings
hints: os.Environ() returns "KEY=value" strings. Split each at its first "=" with strings.Cut, because values can contain "=" too.
Keep the entries whose key starts with the prefix (strings.CutPrefix), and skip any whose key is empty after removing the prefix.
Lowercase the rest of the key with strings.ToLower. Entries without "=" are malformed, so skip them.
